fila.promptBase: A clean, side-profile medium shot of a professional wearing a tailored suit. In a surreal composition, the top of their head is horizontally sliced open like a flat platform, revealing a miniature scene: a tiny, identical version of the person sitting at a small wooden desk in an ergonomic black chair, working on a laptop. The lighting is soft, diffused studio light from a 45-degree angle, creating gentle highlights on the face and soft shadows on the neck. The background is a heavily out-of-focus abstract pattern of sage green and soft white geometric shapes. Shot with an 85mm lens at f/2.8, chest-up crop, eye-level camera. Muted color palette with natural contrast.
fila.assinatura: A sharp, modern professional with glasses, representing focused mental workload.
fila.gancho: Por dentro da mente de um criativo.
variacoes: a woman in her late 30s with a sharp bob haircut and wire-rimmed glasses wearing a beige blazer
a young Black man with a neat fade haircut wearing a minimalist charcoal turtleneck
an East Asian woman in her 40s with elegant updo hair wearing a structured navy blazer
a man in his late 20s with short curly hair and a light beard wearing an olive green modern suit jacket
fila.figura: Focused creative designer or corporate executive

fila.promptBase: An extreme close-up fisheye portrait of [SUBJECT] looking directly into the camera. Shot on a 15mm ultra-wide lens placed very close to the face, causing a dramatic bulbous distortion where the eyes and nose are prominent, and shoulders recede. The subject wears retro purple-tinted rectangular sunglasses and holds a vintage metallic flip phone to their ear. Lit by a soft, diffused circular ring light directly in front, creating subtle circular catchlights. The background is a light grey studio backdrop framed by a dark, circular vignette. Vibrant color grading with warm tones, a hint of retro film grain, and slight chromatic aberration at the edges.
fila.assinatura: A stylish youth from the early 2000s fashion scene, wearing retro purple-tinted sunglasses and holding a vintage flip phone
fila.gancho: Recrie a estética marcante e distorcida dos anos 2000 em seus retratos.
variacoes: a young woman with spiky space buns and metallic silver eyeshadow
a cool guy with a bleach-blonde buzzcut and a silver chain necklace
a young skater with a backwards red cap and beaded choker
a trendy woman with thin eyebrows and a blue denim jacket

publicados.promptBase: A professional medium close-up portrait of [SUBJECT] shot on an 85mm lens. Soft, dramatic directional studio lighting from the side casts gentle shadows, creating a refined, introspective atmosphere. The background is a solid, neutral matte gray. Moody, minimalist color palette featuring rich black apparel. Shallow depth of field, sharp focus, and a clean photographic texture.
publicados.gancho: Como transmitir autoridade e sofisticação de forma silenciosa.
variacoes: A confident female CEO in a black turtleneck, looking thoughtfully away
A thoughtful young tech founder with hands clasped in front of them
An elegant mature writer resting their chin on their hand
A minimalist fashion designer in a black wool sweater, in a three-quarter pose

publicados.promptBase: A chest-up portrait of [SUBJECT], centered, looking directly into the camera with a calm, confident expression. The subject is surrounded by roughly twelve professional DSLR cameras with large telephoto lenses held by unseen hands, packed tightly in an overlapping semi-circle framing the face. Lit by a single hard overhead key light at a 45-degree downward angle, casting deep shadows under the brow, nose, and chin. Pitch-black background. Shot on an 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field softly blurring the outer lenses. Desaturated, high-contrast color grading with a neutral 5500K white balance, crushed deep blacks, and muted skin tones with no color cast.
publicados.assinatura: Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson, a bald, highly muscular man in his early 50s with a strong, broad jawline, clean-shaven face, and intense, calm eyes
publicados.gancho: O estilo paparazzi definitivo: controle absoluto sob os holofotes.
